title: 📊 Consolidated Global Indices Table — India's rank, Jan-Mar 2026
summary: | Index | India Rank/Score | Month | Key Note |

blocks.content:
| Index | India Rank/Score | Month | Key Note |

|---|---|---|---|

| Global Soft Power Index 2026 | 32nd, 48.0 | Jan | Slipped 2 places y-o-y |

| Henley Passport Index | 80th (Jan) → 75th (Feb) | Jan/Feb | Feb: 56 countries (down from 57) — rank rose, destinations fell |

| Network Readiness Index 2025 | 45th (↑4), 54.43 | Feb | #1 in telecom investment, AI publications |

| Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 | 91st/182, score 39 | Feb | Denmark #1, 8th year running |

| Global AI Brain Race 2026 | 6th, 32/100 | Feb | US #1, 82/100 |

| UBS Billionaire Ambition Report | 3rd, 188 billionaires | Feb | US 924, China 470 |

| Responsible Nations Index (1st edn) | 16th/154 | Jan | Singapore #1 |

| Asia Manufacturing Index 2026 | 6th/11 | Jan | China #1 |

| Global Innovation Index | 81 → 38 (improved) | Feb | Announced at AI Impact Summit — see Section 4 |

| Global Terrorism Index 2026 (13th edn) | 13th, score 6.428 | Mar | Worst 5: Pakistan, Burkina Faso, Niger, Nigeria, Mali |

| Fiscal Health Index 2026 (2nd edn, NITI Aayog) | — (covers 18 major + 10 NE/Himalayan states) | Mar | FY2023-24; 5 parameters |

| SKYTRAX World Airport Awards 2026 | Delhi 32→28 (global top 30) | Mar | Changi won 13th time; Hyderabad 43rd, Goa Manohar 64th, Mumbai 66th |

| QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026 | 99 institutions ranked, 4th globally by count | Mar | after US, China, UK |

| Brand Finance Banking 500 (2026) | HDFC Bank 31st ($12.4bn); SBI 56th ($8.1bn, AAA+ rated) | Mar | 19 Indian banks featured |

| Most Valuable Telecom Brands 2026 | Airtel 17th; Jio 23rd | Mar | Deutsche Telekom = most valuable telecom brand globally |

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Cross-index trap across the quarter: the Henley "rank up, destinations down" paradox (Jan 80th/55→Feb 75th/56) and HDFC Bank(31st)-vs-SBI(56th) are both genuine standalone flashcard-worthy trap pairs.
